<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xQ_25ZEEVIB0qi9pHuL-"> <mxGraphModel dx="1229" dy="627" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TD
 subgraph Client Tier [\"Client Tier\"]
 node_mobile[\"«device»<br><b>Mobile App / Browser</b><br>──────────────<br>Execution Environment: React Native / Web Engine\"]
 node_terminal[\"«device»<br><b>Desk Check-in Terminal</b><br>──────────────<br>Execution Environment: Embedded Kiosk OS\"]
 end

 subgraph Edge Tier [\"Edge / Gateway Tier\"]
 node_gateway[\"«execution environment»<br><b>API Gateway & Load Balancer</b><br>──────────────<br>Artifact: Nginx / AWS ALB<br>Role: TLS Termination & Routing\"]
 end

 subgraph App Tier [\"Application Tier (Cloud K8s Cluster)\"]
 node_app1[\"«execution environment»<br><b>Booking Service Pod 1</b><br>──────────────<br>Artifact: Docker / Node.js Runtime\"]
 node_app2[\"«execution environment»<br><b>Booking Service Pod 2</b><br>──────────────<br>Artifact: Docker / Node.js Runtime\"]
 node_worker[\"«execution environment»<br><b>Background Worker</b><br>──────────────<br>Artifact: Async Notification Worker\"]
 end

 subgraph Data Tier [\"Data & External Persistence Tier\"]
 node_db[(\"«database»<br><b>Primary Database</b><br>──────────────<br>DBMS: PostgreSQL 15<br>Role: Relational Store\")]
 node_cache[(\"«cache»<br><b>Cache & Lock Engine</b><br>──────────────<br>Engine: Redis Cluster<br>Role: Slot Locking & Sessions\")]
 node_email[\"«external system»<br><b>Email Gateway</b><br>──────────────<br>Protocol: HTTPS / SMTP API\"]
 end

 %% Network Connections & Protocols
 node_mobile -- \"«HTTPS / TLS 1.3»\" --> node_gateway
 node_terminal -- \"«HTTPS / TLS 1.3»\" --> node_gateway

 node_gateway -- \"«HTTP Reverse Proxy»\" --> node_app1
 node_gateway -- \"«HTTP Reverse Proxy»\" --> node_app2

 node_app1 -- \"«TCP / SQL»\" --> node_db
 node_app2 -- \"«TCP / SQL»\" --> node_db

 node_app1 -- \"«RESP Protocol»\" --> node_cache
 node_app2 -- \"«RESP Protocol»\" --> node_cache

 node_app1 -- \"«AMQP / Event Bus»\" --> node_worker
 node_worker -- \"«HTTPS API»\" --> node_email",
 "config": null
